notes: §1985:IV.6.4.2.1.1.1 GR5 names as a conditional phrase the "NO DATA or WITH DATA phrase when specified within a RECEIVE statement": the phrase carries the action taken on the statement's condition and makes the RECEIVE that writes it conditional. The grammar gives the 1985 communication RECEIVE its two phrases as receiveNoDataPhrase and receiveWithDataPhrase, each a statementBlock operand, and VersionConformancePass.VisitCommunicationReceiveStatement (construct communication-facility-removed-2014) admits the statement at --std 85. ConditionalStatements.IsConditional classifies from the parse, not from a verb list: a statement whose own syntax holds a statementBlock and no END-RECEIVE is conditional, and ProcedureFormatPass.VisitStatementBlock refuses one (COBOL2796) wherever a format takes an imperative-statement, at every edition; CommunicationEmitter.EmitReceive runs the WITH DATA or the NO DATA statements by the receipt's answer. The witness is a RECEIVE ... NO DATA CONTINUE as the operand of ADD ON SIZE ERROR, refused at 85. Probes at --std 85: a RECEIVE with WITH DATA alone, and one with both phrases, are each refused inside ADD ON SIZE ERROR; a NO DATA RECEIVE and a WITH DATA RECEIVE each closed by END-RECEIVE, a RECEIVE with neither phrase (imperative), a phrase-bearing RECEIVE as IF's statement-1 and one ending a sentence all compile.

next.reason: 1985: "NO DATA or WITH DATA phrase when specified within a RECEIVE statement."; 2023: "RECEIVE now has only ON EXCEPTION / NOT ON EXCEPTION and CONTINUE phrases; the communication module's NO DATA/WITH DATA is gone". The 2023 RECEIVE is message-based and has no NO DATA or WITH DATA phrase, so this conditional-statement case no longer exists.
